name: code-ontology-companion
description: Apply source-backed code exploration to your current task. Search authorized Java/Spring and Python code, trace static dependencies, and explore snapshots in an offline 3D workbench.

interface.longDescription: Explore authorized Java/Spring and Python code with immutable local snapshots. Start with a relevant symbol search or bounded static impact lookup through actually exposed local MCP tools; use the verified bundled CLI when needed. The complete local package provides eleven read-only tools, including pinned module-catalog queries and bounded evidence bundles. An offline 3D workbench in HTML provides structure, impact and changes views, keyboard and text routes, complete paged inventory, source evidence, and visible coverage limits. Deterministic analysis does not execute target code or make network requests. Static relationships do not prove runtime behavior or current authorization. Inspect rule-attributed relationship evidence and adapter coverage, including unresolved boundaries. Optional separately authorized local inference remains outside observed evidence.
capabilities: Current-conversation application with an actual first lookup
Capability-aware routing and authorized change checkpoints
Offline 3D structure, impact, and changes workbench
Exact symbol search and pinned snapshot reads
Directional static dependency paths with source evidence
Auditable relationship evidence and adapter coverage
Selected portable code references and RDF export
Keyboard navigation and accessible paged text fallback
Three display depths and one/two/three-hop call highlights
Complete indexed inventory through explicit expansion and pagination
Persistent source-root selection and duplicate-declaration detection
Bounded static evidence bundles for source-backed answers
defaultPrompt: Apply Code Ontology Companion to this project and use it to help with my current task.
If I change OrderService, what code may be affected? Show static evidence and runtime limitations.
Use the ontology products available here for this task, starting with a real lookup or selected-artifact check.
